name: ai-agent-monitor

screen.note: A 240x240 colour display on a desk clock, with no input: display components only. Lengths (padding, margin, gap, width, height) are character cells as in Ink: 1 cell is 6 px across, 1 row is 16 px. Text is ASCII (accents are dropped). The root is a Box filling the screen; the background is black unless the root sets backgroundColor.

upload: POST /api/faces?name=<1-20 of a-z 0-9 _ ->&show=1 with the spec as the body (X-Api-Key header). The reply lists anything drawn approximately. Values change later without a new upload: POST /api/faces/vars {"name": value}.

state.note: Read with {"$state": path}, "${path}" inside {"$template": ...}, $cond and visible. Values update on the clock by themselves.

paths./vars/<name>: A variable pushed by an agent (POST /api/faces/vars {"build": "ok"}); 1-15 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _. Use {"$state": "/vars/x", "fallback": "idle"} for a value not pushed yet
paths./now/temp: the temperature now; also /now/feels, /now/hum, /now/wind, /now/text (light rain), /now/icon (wi-day-rain), /now/rain_in (minutes until rain)
paths./days/0/high: today's high; /days/0 to /days/4: high, low, rain (chance %), wday3, icon
paths./msg/title: the latest agent message: title, text, count

dynamic.$cond: {"$cond": {"$state": "/vars/build", "eq": "fail"}, "$then": "red", "$else": "green"}; conditions: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, not, $and, $or
dynamic.visible: on an element: {"$state": "/vars/build", "eq": "running"}. A hidden element keeps its space

colors: Hex (#rgb, #rrggbb), rgb()/rgba(), terminal names (red green yellow blue magenta cyan white gray black, and ...Bright), CSS names, or the clock's theme roles (@text, @muted, @accent1, @ok, @warn, @error, @info, @time, @panel).

Box.description: Flex container (Ink). Default direction row. Use flexDirection column to stack.

props.borderStyle: single | double | round | bold (drawn as a 1-2 px line; round has corners)

Text.description: A line of text, wrapped to the box (fonts: 16 px; fontSize above 19 gives the 26 px font, above 31 the large line font, capitals only).

props.font: big | bebas | outfit | seg7 | pixel (clock extension: large display fonts; bebas/outfit/seg7/pixel draw digits only)
props.maxChars: number: reserve room for a live value this long (clock extension)

Heading.description: A heading: h1 large line font, h2/h3 26 px, h4 16 px.

Newline.description: Blank rows in a column Box.

Spacer.description: Fills the free space on the main axis (pushes siblings apart).

Divider.description: Horizontal line, with an optional centred title.

Spinner.description: A ring that steps every second, with a label.

Sparkline.description: A line chart: data (fixed values), or state: a variable pushed with $history (live, last 32 values).

Table.description: Rows of small text in columns (keep to 3-4 columns, 6-8 rows).

ListItem.description: One row: leading mark, title, subtitle under it, trailing value at the right.

Card.description: A panel with a title, grouping its children (column).

KeyValue.description: label at the left, value at the right, on one line.

StatusLine.description: An icon (check, cross, warning, info) and a message.

Metric.description: A big value with its label, a trend arrow and a detail line (76 px tall).

Callout.description: A block with a coloured left border.

props.items: [{title, description?, date?, status: completed | current | upcoming}]

Markdown.description: Plain text with # headings and - bullets (inline markup removed).

Clock.description: Clock extension: the time or date, large.

props.format: hm | hms | date | wday | wday3 | dmy | ampm

Icon.description: Clock extension: SVG path data drawn into a square (Lucide icons work as they are: 24x24, stroked). One path, or paths with their own colours.

props.d: path data or an array of them

WeatherIcon.description: Clock extension: a weather icon; name defaults to the current weather.

Ring.description: Clock extension: a progress ring from 12 o'clock, with an optional centre label.

also_accepted: Specs for @json-render/image (Frame, Box as a column, Row, Column, Heading, Text with fontSize/fontWeight, Divider, Spacer; lengths in px) and the display parts of @json-render/shadcn (Stack, Grid, Separator, Alert, Progress, Avatar, Skeleton, Button drawn at rest) also draw. Not supported: input components, actions, on/watch, $computed, repeat, Image (no photos from URLs).
rules: The screen is small (40 x 15 cells): one idea per screen, 3-6 elements of content, large type for the main value.
Use flexDirection column on the root Box; Spacer or justifyContent space-between to spread things out.
For live text give maxChars so its box fits the longest value.
At most 96 elements; the compiled face holds at most 64 drawn items (a Table cell, a List line and a bar each count).
